# Static site on SiteGround: generated by scripts/siteground/export-static.mjs
# (template: scripts/siteground/htaccess.txt). Edit the template, not this file.

Options -MultiViews -Indexes
DirectoryIndex index.html index.php
ErrorDocument 404 /_sg/404.php
AddDefaultCharset UTF-8
AddType application/rss+xml .rss

<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
RewriteEngine On
RewriteBase /

# www -> main domain
RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^www\.{{HOST_RE}}$ [NC]
RewriteRule ^(.*)$ https://{{HOST}}/$1 [R=301,L]

# Forms: Elementor posts to /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php, answered by PHP
RewriteRule ^wp-admin/admin-ajax\.php$ /_sg/ajax.php [L,END]

{{SEARCH}}

# Sitemaps and feed (Yoast URLs)
RewriteRule ^sitemap\.xml$ /sitemap_index.xml [R=301,L]
RewriteRule ^feed/?$ /feed.xml [L,T=application/rss+xml]

# Sanity Studio: every /cms/... URL loads the Studio app
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} !-f
RewriteRule ^cms(/.*)?$ /cms/index.html [L]

# Redirects carried over from WordPress (content/redirects.json)
{{REDIRECTS}}
</IfModule>

<IfModule mod_headers.c>
Header always set X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
Header always set Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
Header always set Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains"
<If "%{REQUEST_URI} =~ m#^/(assets|_next/static)/#">
Header set Cache-Control "public, max-age=31536000, immutable"
</If>
<ElseIf "%{REQUEST_URI} =~ m#^/(wp-content|wp-includes)/#">
Header set Cache-Control "public, max-age=604800, stale-while-revalidate=86400"
</ElseIf>
<ElseIf "%{REQUEST_URI} =~ m#(/|\.html)$#">
Header set Cache-Control "public, max-age=0, must-revalidate"
</ElseIf>
</IfModule>
